title: NO FEAR
content:
What happens if we don't stop playing? 
Three actors improvise for three days without interruption. They stay in character, even when the camera is not rolling. The basic agreement is that we keep playing.
 

performed by Amélie Hug, Alexandra Huss and Milena Kaltenbach 
 

Image by Mirko Hans, Sound Steven Boreham, Music by Mo Beiküfner, Photographs by Marie Eberhardt, Assistant Camera Friedemann Röse, directed by Daniel Huss

details.text_middle: After a year of preparation in Zurich, we traveled to Brandenburg with a small team of 10 people. I was fascinated by the idea of completely improvising and going into the shoot without a script. We were driven by curiosity about something we didn't know what it was. After playing and shooting for 24 hours, the dynamics between the characters became more and more diffuse for the actors and the team. It took us 48 hours to find a common rhythm. The camera was in the right places at the right time. On the last day of shooting, we went to a rave in Berlin and shot the climax of the film, which later became the starting point of the story in the edit.
